fact_text: The analyst said the Punjab flood, with heavy water in the Ravi and Sutlej rivers, is the largest since 1988 and raises crop, livestock and food-security risks.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: The analyst cited a contact's estimate that floodwater from across the border could reach Sindh around 4 to 5 September 2025.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: Punjab's canal system is well developed, so the analyst expected some canal-irrigated crops to survive the flood better than riverside villages.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: Livestock losses were a major part of the flood damage, which the analyst said adds to food-security concerns over time.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: Rice is sown from July and land is prepared in September and October, so flood silt on fields could reduce fertilizer demand for the wheat crop sown from October to December.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: Fertilizer dealers the analyst spoke to estimated sales could fall by 8 to 10 percent, though the analyst expected the overall impact to be limited.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: The analyst named Fauji Fertilizer, Engro Fertilizer, Fatima Fertilizer and Agritech as the companies where flood-related fertilizer sales are most at risk.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: Cement and steel demand could improve as government rehabilitation work follows the flood, so the analyst saw the damage as having both negative and positive effects.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: DG Khan Cement and Maple Leaf Cement are the main northern-zone cement names the analyst watches, given their large capacity in Punjab.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: DG Khan Cement's nine-month EPS was about PKR 12, and the final quarter saw higher dispatches and exports.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: The analyst expected DG Khan Cement's performance to improve in FY26 if cement dispatches pick up, with FY26 already under way.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: Mughal Steel is described as a premium, high-capacity steel maker that also makes girders and other long steel products alongside rebar.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: The analyst said flood losses in one area can create opportunities for steel and cement makers elsewhere, such as the Badami Bagh and Lahore plants.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: Engro Holdings' second-quarter 2025 EPS came in at about PKR 28 to 29, but the analyst said this was lifted by a one-off revaluation rather than operations.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: Engro Holdings booked a revaluation of its thermal assets, with an entry of about PKR 68 billion across two carrying-value entries, linked to its power and coal-mining subsidiaries.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: The analyst said the consolidated accounts matter more than the EPS, because the revaluation has not been realised in cash, so he viewed it positively but not as operating strength.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)

fact_text: Engro Holdings did not pay a dividend at the holding level for the period, an outcome the analyst said was expected.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 28 August 2025 | Flood Impact on FFC, EFERT & Cement Sector | Engro Holdings Result' (YouTube, 2025-08-28)
